correctness.rationale: An honest PGL2 representation on eight-dimensional cubic pairs is provided by det(g)^-1 g^-1 F(gv); its conic-torsor twist is affine eight-space over Q. Resultant and trivial-aut open remains nonempty (explicit witness certified), and quotient map remains dominant. Any Q-model on P1 would yield a unique Gal-invariant conjugacy to the C-model and split nonsplit C, impossible. Q points of the nonempty open are Zariski dense, as is the image. Proof is uniform across all nonsplit conics.

value.rationale: Prescribes an arbitrary exact nontrivial quaternion descent obstruction and proves its locus Zariski dense in four-dimensional cubic dynamical moduli. This addresses a mathematically motivated geometric coverage question not settled by any finite-height census or pointwise splitting criterion, with an explicit uniform dominant construction. No claimed height-asymptotic conclusion.
